title: Local proxies for memory-efficient training
abstract: arXiv:2610.23145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Local learning algorithms can reshape resource requirements of artificial intelligence. The memory bottleneck of standard end-to-end backpropagation lies in the need to store all network activations until the loss gradient has been propagated back through. Local learning avoids this, but typically at a cost in accuracy. We study how to achieve accurate and memory efficient local learning in transformers. For each transformer block, we train a local proxy network to predict the global network output via distillation. Gradients can be independently propagated through this local proxy while estimating well the backpropagation gradients. In theory, this approach is exact for deep linear networks; in non-linear residual models, the gradient error can be bounded when using the appropriate residual proxy. translated_title: 用于内存高效训练的局部代理网络
translated_abstract: 局部学习算法能够重塑人工智能的资源需求。标准端到端反向传播的内存瓶颈在于必须存储所有网络激活，直到损失梯度反向传播完成。局部学习可以避免这一问题，但通常以精度下降为代价。我们研究了如何在Transformer中实现准确且内存高效的局部学习。对于每个Transformer块，我们通过知识蒸馏训练一个局部代理网络来预测全局网络输出。梯度可以独立地通过该局部代理进行传播，同时能够很好地估计反向传播梯度。理论上，该方法对于深度线性网络是精确的；在非线性残差模型中，使用适当的残差代理可以将梯度误差限定在边界内。我们通过数值实验验证了这一点，并证明优化蒸馏损失可以改善梯度估计。
tldr: 提出为每个Transformer块训练局部代理网络，通过蒸馏预测全局输出使梯度可局部独立传播，在大幅降低训练内存占用的同时保持接近标准反向传播的梯度估计精度。
en_tdlr: Proposes training a local proxy network for each transformer block via distillation, enabling gradients to propagate locally and independently, achieving memory-efficient training while accurately approximating backpropagation gradients.
